verdict.rationale: As an instruction-tuned LLM, Llama is used through natural-language prompts. Docs cite function calling, agent-optimized inference and "multi-agent coding in your terminal," and a community user describes operating it through the Meta Chat UI. However, the product's own tooling (the llama-model CLI for list, download and verify) is driven by flag-based commands, not natural language, and there is no documented natural-language control surface for managing the product. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of the product's tooling and management (download, configuration), detailed docs on the terminal agent experience, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language command workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Llama 3.1 provides significant new features, including function calling and agent-optimized inference
Initial observations from the Meta Chat UI: fast, less censored than other mainstream models, has current data, cites sources.
